approval_ref: The user approved the management-first CRIP direction and explicitly asked to start a new bounded evidence-loop feature without deleting existing behavior.
notes: Keep the legacy question endpoint and QA V2 unchanged; add QA V3 beside them.
Do not request, expose or persist hidden chain-of-thought. Persist only structured decisions, evidence requests and final cited answers.
Limit one question to three model decisions and two evidence-acquisition rounds; never retry a failed provider call automatically.
The first slice supports only project-scoped exact-identifier and text-search supplementation. Visual supplementation remains on QA V2.
Tests use MockTransport or Mock mode and make no external or paid provider call.
title: Add bounded evidence-loop QA V3
objective: Introduce an independent QA V3 state machine that lets one model either return a claim-bound QA V2 answer, request narrowly scoped local evidence, ask the user for a missing project file, or stop, while retaining all existing product paths.
